data.description:
# Intake Brief — Move to integer numbers for coins and reputation (CG-0MTIO1M15001E9Y6)

## Problem statement

Coins and reputation currently use fractional decimals (e.g. `2.3`, `0.05`) across the CSV and engine. Floating point accumulation and mixed `toFixed(1/2/3)` display makes values hard to reason about and compare. The codebase should operate entirely on whole numbers.

## Users

- **Game designer / balancer** — wants to read and tune card values as integers without mental decimal conversion; needs CSV to be the single source of truth.
- **Player** — sees clean integer coin/reputation values in HUD, tooltips, card text, and logs without spurious decimals like `5.000` or `2.30`.

### User stories

- As a designer, I can open `card-data.csv` and see every coin/reputation-relevant field as an integer so that I can balance without chasing floating-point rounding errors.
- As a player, I see coins and reputation as whole numbers everywhere in the UI so that feedback is immediate and consistent.
- As a developer, any coin/reputation calculation yields an integer (rounded to nearest) so that game state never accumulates fractional drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **CSV integer migration** — Every coin/reputation-relevant column in `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` (`cost`, `baseIncome`, `reputationPerTurn`, `synergyCoinBonus`, `synergyRepBonus`, `ongoingCost`, `incomeBonus`, `reputationBonus`, `coinDelta`, `reputationDelta`, `synergyRangeBonus`, plus staff/effect multipliers where they represent coin/rep amounts) is multiplied by 100 and rounded to the nearest integer (`Math.round`). No fractional values remain in those columns; synergy *rates* that are true percentages (0–1 range) are called out explicitly if kept as decimals, otherwise also scaled.
2. **No decimal formatting in UI** — All `toFixed(1/2/3)` and `formatCurrency` decimal paths for coins/reputation are removed or switched to integer rendering: HUD bar (`MainStreetRenderer`, `MainStreetOverlayContent`), tooltips (`MainStreetHudTooltips`), card SVGs (`MainStreetCardSvgGenerator`), activity logs (`MainStreetAdjacency`, `MainStreetState`), and `src/core-engine/I18n.ts` `formatCurrency` behavior for these fields. Spot-check: HUD shows `Coins: 123` not `Coins: 123.00`.
3. **Calculations round to nearest integer** — Every coin/reputation arithmetic path rounds its result to the nearest integer (e.g. synergy product `baseIncome * synergyRate * adjacency`, `applyReputationMultiplier`, `applyReputationMultiplier`, event deltas, ongoing-cost deductions, sell/premium pricing, income multiplier effects) using `Math.round` semantics. Document the rounding boundary (applied per-card/per-event/per-turn vs. single final aggregation) in a code comment at the central helper(s).
4. **Tests and balance artifacts updated** — All affected unit/browser tests are updated to expect integer values and pass; any checked-in balance snapshots or CSV-derived artifacts (e.g. card SVGs, checksums) are regenerated. Full project test suite passes.
5. **Documentation updated** — Code comments, `docs/` and `example-games/main-street/README.md` or `docs/main-street/*` references that describe decimal precision (e.g. "3dp", "to 2 decimal places") are revised to describe integer semantics. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.

## Constraints

- **Source of truth is `card-data.csv`** — CSV migration is `value * 100 → Math.round`; keep integer costs already correct (e.g. `3 → 300`); do not hand-tweak individual values outside that rule unless a follow-up balance pass is explicitly scoped.
- **No floating-point drift** — After this change `state.resourceBank.coins` and `state.resourceBank.reputation` must remain integers through normal play; avoid reintroducing fractional intermediates without rounding.
- **Backwards-compatibility note** — Saved games / transcripts that contain decimal coin/rep values will be incompatible; call out migration or intentional breakage in the PR description; no silent coercion that masks data loss.
- **Scope guard** — Synergy *rates* vs. amounts: if any `synergyCoinBonus`/`synergyRepBonus` field is defined as a true rate (e.g. `0.5 = 50%`) rather than an amount, confirm its intended semantics before scaling; record the decision in the work item.
- **Minimal churn** — Touch only coin/reputation paths; unrelated numeric systems (e.g. `multiplier` for income-multiplier events like `0.8`, turn counters) are out of scope unless they feed coin/rep calculations.

## Existing state

- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` contains fractional coin/rep fields (`baseIncome 2.3`, `reputationPerTurn 0.05`, `ongoingCost 0.75`, `coinDelta -2` alongside fractional event deltas, etc.).
- UI formats with `toFixed(2)` (HUD), `toFixed(3)` (logs/adjacency), `toFixed(1)` (reputation/synergy rate labels), and `formatCurrency` which currently renders whatever number is passed.
- Engine accumulates floats in `resourceBank`, `EconomyLedger`, and per-turn income/reputation resolution (`MainStreetEngine`, `MainStreetAdjacency`, `MainStreetMarket`, `MainStreetDifficulty`).
- Prior work (CG-0MRER3RE300418SG, CG-0MSXIQDI4007K6N0) addressed rounding/display in isolation; this item unifies on integers.

## Desired change

- Migrate all coin/reputation CSV values to integers (`Math.round(value * 100)`), strip decimal formatting from every UI surface, and make every coin/reputation calculation round to the nearest integer so the entire economy is integer-only.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — Scale all coin/rep columns ×100 and round.
- `src/core-engine/I18n.ts` — Adjust `formatCurrency` / currency rendering to integer display for migrated fields.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts` — Remove `toFixed(2)` HUD formatting; render integer coins/rep.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — Remove `toFixed(2)` game-over overlay.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` — Remove `toFixed(3)`/`toFixed(1)` coin/rep displays.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetCardSvgGenerator.ts` — Integer cost/reputation rendering; `toFixed(1)` helper removal.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — Integer synergy math and log formatting (`toFixed(3)`).
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` — `describeEventEffects` integer formatting.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetDifficulty.ts` — `applyReputationMultiplier` / `reputationCoinMultiplier` rounding.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — Ongoing-cost, event, favour, bankruptcy log (`toFixed(3)`) and any coin/rep arithmetic.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts` — Sell value, premium cost, hire/upgrade logs and arithmetic.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCards.ts` — CSV parsing / type contracts for migrated columns.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetFormatting.ts` — Tooltip/card text formatters (rate vs amount handling).
- `tests/main-street/**` — Update expectations from fractional to integer values.

## Related work

- **Potentially related docs**
  - `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — canonical card/effect data; source of the decimal values.
  - `src/core-engine/I18n.ts` — `formatCurrency` and currency symbol handling.
  - `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md` / `docs/main-street/balancing-methodology.md` — describe card values and balance methodology (check for decimal-precision language).
  - `example-games/main-street/README.md` — documents CSV as source of truth.

- **Potentially related work items**
  - `Show HUD bar money and reputation to 2 decimal places (CG-0MSXIQDI4007K6N0)` — completed; established `toFixed(2)` HUD behavior now being removed.
  - `Income rounding error: fractional baseIncome lost via Math.floor in applyReputationMultiplier (CG-0MRER3RE300418SG)` — completed; fixed rounding loss that this integer migration supersedes.
  - `Tooltips on businesses are confusing (CG-0MT5Y9AD2001MKWZ)` — completed; touched tooltip coin/rep formatting (`formatCurrency` / integer conventions).
  - `When selling a businesses in Main Street sale price should reflect value of business (CG-0MT5XO7DI0066QCT)` — completed; sell-value formula (`Math.ceil`/`Math.floor`) that must now operate on integer inputs.
  - Search `wl search "coins reputation integer"` surfaced 5 items; worktree scans confirm decimal patterns cluster in Main Street engine/scenes.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk: rate vs. amount ambiguity** — `synergyCoinBonus`/`synergyRepBonus` could be rates (e.g. `0.5 = 50%`) not amounts; blindly ×100 would inflate them 100×. Mitigation: verify semantics before migration (check `MainStreetAdjacency`/`MainStreetCards` usage); treat true rates as exempt and document.
- **Risk: missed arithmetic paths** — Coin/rep math is spread across Engine/Market/Adjacency/Difficulty/Formatting; a missed `*` or division could reintroduce floats. Mitigation: grep for `coinDelta`/`reputationDelta`/`baseIncome`/`ongoingCost`/`applyReputationMultiplier` and add a central `roundInt` helper.
- **Risk: save/transcript incompatibility** — Integer migration breaks load of old saves/transcripts with fractional values. Mitigation: explicitly version or invalidate old saves; document in release notes.
- **Risk: balance shift** — ×100 with `Math.round` changes effective economy by two orders of magnitude; tunings that felt small before (0.05 rep) become 5. Mitigation: this is intentional per brief; do not rebalance in this item — file a separate balance-pass child if needed.
- **Risk: scope creep (rebalance)** — Temptation to retune costs/income while migrating. Mitigation: strictly apply `×100 + round`; any hand-tuned balance changes go to a linked follow-up work item.
- **Assumption:** All coin/reputation fields should be integers; no field intentionally needs sub-coin granularity after migration.
- **Assumption:** `formatCurrency` should render integer amounts without decimals after this change (e.g. `€300` not `€3.00`); locale symbol handling stays as-is.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

No clarifying questions were asked during this intake. The work item description provided explicit migration rules (CSV ×100 + round, strip decimal formatting, round calculations to nearest integer) and was sufficient to draft a clear brief without an interview round.

- Q: (not asked) — Seed context was sufficient; no producer interview was conducted. Source: `wl show CG-0MTIO1M15001E9Y6 --json` description.
- Research: `wl search "coins reputation integer"` (5 hits) + repo grep for `toFixed`/`formatCurrency`/`coinDelta`/`reputationDelta`/`baseIncome`/`ongoingCost` confirmed decimal usage clusters in `example-games/main-street/` scenes/engine and `src/core-engine/I18n.ts`; `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` sampled directly — fractional fields confirmed (file read). Related work items CG-0MSXIQDI4007K6N0, CG-0MRER3RE300418SG, CG-0MT5Y9AD2001MKWZ, CG-0MT5XO7DI0066QCT summarized from FTS snippets; full descriptions not re-fetched (low signal for AC definition).
data.title: Move to integer numbers for coins and reputation
